info.name: Kigali Clinic Quiz
info.description: Run folders in order against an empty clinic database. Seed requests save all records through the API. Re-running seed requests requires a fresh database. Bulk checks change seed appointments. Specialization save/update owns doctor assignments. The two cancelled bookings are saved before the confirmed booking on October 20.

exec: pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("No appointments yet"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.response.json().forEach(function (o) { pm.collectionVariables.set("office" + (o.officeNumber - 100), o.id); }); });

pm.test("Expected result", function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(rows.every(a => a.status === "SCHEDULED")).to.eql(true); const dates = rows.map(a => a.appointmentDate); pm.expect(dates).to.eql([...dates].sort()); });

pm.test("Expected result", function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(7); pm.expect(rows[0].appointmentDate).to.eql("2026-10-01"); pm.expect(rows[6].appointmentDate).to.eql("2026-10-31"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("Doctor is already booked on that date"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().map(p => p.id); pm.expect(ids.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(3); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("The doctor with that id does not exist"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { const counts = Object.fromEntries(pm.response.json()); pm.expect(counts).to.eql({SCHEDULED:3, CONFIRMED:2, COMPLETED:2, CANCELLED:3}); });

pm.test("Expected result", function () { const page = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(page.totalElements).to.eql(10); pm.expect(page.totalPages).to.eql(2); pm.expect(page.content.length).to.eql(5); pm.expect(page.content[0].appointmentDate).to.eql("2026-11-15"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("3 appointments cancelled"); });

pm.test("Expected result", function () { const rows = pm.response.json().filter(a => a.doctor.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("doctor1")); pm.expect(rows.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(rows.every(a => a.status === "CANCELLED")).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql("0 appointments cancelled"); });
pm.test("Expected result", function () { pm.collectionVariables.set("crudoffices", pm.response.json().find(o => o.officeNumber === 999).id); });
